summary: Strong B2.5 capstone. Walkthrough names fair-share-with-remainder vs. fair-share-with-halves trap with concrete recovery (pre-cut cookies, body-claps analogy). Materials are paper-only with optional puppet path. Worksheet practises both whole and half quotients plus reasoning prompt; consistency is 3 (not 4) because Parts 1-2 closely mirror Stations A/B rather than offering a clear transfer task — the 7-into-4 early finisher is the only stretch.
